label.purpose: Eyebrow text, nav labels, small captions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA button using petroleo action color.
components.html: Venha nos visitar este domingo
components.css: .btn-primary { background: #005f6b; color: #fff; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,95,107,0.22); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(0,95,107,0.30); transform: translateY(-1px); } .btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005f6b; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Outline Dark Button
components.description: Secondary outline button on light backgrounds.
components.html: Conheça o nosso jeito de viver
components.css: .btn-outline-dark { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #1f2421; color: #1f2421; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .btn-outline-dark:hover { background: #1f2421; color: #fff; } .btn-outline-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005f6b; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card with subtle shadow and border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d7ded9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.6rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,67,77,0.06); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,67,77,0.10); } .ds-card h3 { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card p { color: #5b6b63; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #005f6b; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Gradient dark card for emphasis blocks.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #00434d, #005f6b); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.6rem; } .ds-card-dark h3 { color: #fff; } .ds-card-dark p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky header with translucent background and mobile toggle.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 60; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7ded9; backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(10px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: clamp(1.1rem,3vw,2.2rem); height: 72px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 12px; color: #1f2421; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { background: rgba(0,95,107,0.08); color: #005f6b; }

narrative.overview: testsite uses a clean studio identity built from petroleo green, sage neutrals, thin structure, and Montserrat typography. It reads as calm, modern, and grounded.
keyCharacteristics: Vitral-branded token set with petroleo and gem accents
Sticky translucent header and responsive mobile menu
Light card elevation with restrained borders

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Primary color is used for actions and structure; avoid decorative saturation.

rules.name: The One Stack Rule
rules.body: Use Montserrat everywhere; do not introduce additional display fonts without a brand reason.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest; lift appears only on hover/focus.

dos: Do reuse the four-gem strip as a signature accent only.
Do keep mobile nav behavior and accessibility states intact.
Do preserve the petroleo/sage/claro alternation rhythm.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients beyond the defined banner gradient and gem strip.
Don't introduce brand colors outside the token set.
Don't stack multiple heading treatments in one card.
